assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The service in question is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring)
The patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The dizziness and giddiness is coded as R42
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The transient cerebral ischemic attacks is coded as G45.9
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The sick sinus syndrome is coded as I49.5
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The ordering note states the purpose of the mobile cardiac telemetry order
SilverBridge Advantage sent a letter inviting appeal with supporting clinical documentation
The indication establishes the medical necessity of the service
